name: Grand Pacific Petrochemical Corporation
summary: Grand Pacific Petrochemical Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of petrochemical and other chemical products in Taiwan. The company offers styrene monomer, an intermediate used in manufacturing PS resin, ABS resin, styrene butadiene rubber, and unsaturated polyester.
